name: all-plugins
description: Installs every leaf plugin of this marketplace at one scope (local by default) with zero prompts, and uninstalls them again — one script with an exit code (0 done, 1 a plugin failed, 2 the marketplace is not added), driven by /all-plugins:install and /all-plugins:uninstall or run straight from the marketplace clone. The cost is measured, not guessed: with everything installed the host's skill listing overflows its budget (~6.6x at 200k, ~1.3x at 1M) and the overflow goes name-only; whether that changes what fires was measured once at zero delta (rationale/2026-09-15-listing-eviction-probe.md). Never installs a bundle, never prompts, never picks for you — that is /stack-scan:suggest.
